facts.subject: owner-approval
facts.aliases: одобрение владельца что требует Юрия решай сам спроси меня owner approval owner gate что нельзя без владельца
facts.fact: Exactly three subjects stay with the owner (ADR-285): (1) real money movement — execution, keys, payments, going live; (2) public yield numbers, tier naming, legal wording; (3) irreversible actions — data deletion, external publication, external commitments. Plus actions the agent physically cannot do (sudo, creating repos). Everything else the agent decides and records in the journal.

facts.subject: fleet-acceptance-incident
facts.aliases: Fleet Acceptance инцидент восстановление приёмка флота канарейка что случилось
facts.fact: 2026-09-29 the trusted-bootstrap canary exited 2/CRITICAL; three of four findings were defects of the acceptance INSTRUMENT, not the fleet: the acceptance receipt was written into the immutable release, launcher exec model, fleet interpreter path. Fixed by ADR-516 (immutable release ≠ mutable operational state; single-source fleet_python); the phase was then accepted (approved release 4cb68535).

facts.subject: proposed-vs-implemented
facts.aliases: предложенная реализованная фича описанное отличие работающее proposed implemented feature L2 L4 зрелость
facts.fact: A proposed feature (idea, draft, design doc) is not an implemented one. Design docs carry a maturity level: L2 = document exists, no code; L3 = code but not really working; L4 = code + tests + data; L5 = live agent (.claude/rules/design-docs.md, docs/MATURITY_REGISTER.md). Memory statuses: PROPOSED ≠ ACCEPTED ≠ ACTIVE; an idea in docs/ideas is not an instruction until #promote.

facts.subject: defi-packages
facts.aliases: три пакета тиры Conservative Balanced Aggressive Консервативный Сбалансированный Агрессивный Preserve Core Max Yield packages tiers что держат книги
facts.fact: Measured 2026-10-01: Conservative = main cycle_runner book under RiskPolicy v1.0 (T1 45% / T2 50%, 100 evidenced days); Balanced = hy_cycle sleeve (data/hy_paper_trading.json), Aggressive = lp_cycle sleeve (data/lp_paper_trading.json), both OUTSIDE RiskPolicy with own kills -8% / -25%. All three hold only single-asset stablecoin lending/savings; 'aggressive' = concentration (2 names up to 60%) + wider stop, not riskier protocols or complex mechanics. Loops/PT/YT/LP/delta-neutral/basis run only in advisory labs.

facts.subject: defi-p0-gaps
facts.aliases: P0 дефекты DeFi безопасность корректность газ рукава kill switch red flags peg_monitor сайт solicitation
facts.fact: DeFi gap audit P0s (ADR-530) — status after ADR-531 (2026-10-01): P0-1 FIXED — sleeve books use economics model sleeve-econ-v2 (no gas on accrual drift; v1 rows kept, classified DISTORTED, boundary in book state); P0-2 FIXED — kill-switch triggers have outcomes TRIGGERED/CLEAR/PARTIAL/NOT_APPLICABLE/UNMEASURED, unmeasured red flags ⇒ cycle FAIL-SAFE HOLD (no liquidation), live flags decided by category provenance; P0-3 FIXED — peg_monitor has no synthetic 1.0, prices from adapter or RTMR quorum, watches held positions, GREEN only when all measured; P0-4 OPEN — public wording package awaits the owner (subject 2).

facts.subject: defi-two-dimensional-risk
facts.aliases: протокольный риск стратегический риск механика две оси protocol risk strategy risk mechanic loop supply одно измерение
facts.fact: Protocol risk and strategy (mechanic) risk are ONE dimension today: tier T1/T2/T3 + one risk_score per adapter, StrategySpec.tier reuses protocol labels; the only mechanic attribute (is_delta_neutral) is stamped True on every sleeve leg. An Aave loop would inherit Aave's T1 cap. vNext adds a mechanic axis, advisory until an ADR (RiskPolicy v1.0 frozen).
